summary: TR Property Investment Trust plc is a closed-ended equity mutual fund launched by F&C Investment Business Ltd. The fund is managed by Thames River Capital LLP. It invests in public equity markets of Europe. The fund seeks to invest in stocks of companies that are operating in the real estate sector. It primarily invests in growth stocks of companies across all market capitalizations. The fund also makes direct investments in property. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the FTSE EPRA/NAREIT Developed Europe Capped Net Total Return Index. TR Property Investment Trust plc was formed in 1905 and is domiciled in the United Kingdom.
summary_fr: TR Property Investment Trust plc est un fonds commun de placement d'actions à capital fixe lancé par F&C Investment Business Ltd. Le fonds est géré par Thames River Capital LLP. Il investit sur les marchés boursiers publics européens. Le fonds cherche à investir dans des actions de sociétés opérant dans le secteur immobilier. Il investit principalement dans des actions de croissance de sociétés de toutes capitalisations boursières. Le fonds réalise également des investissements directs dans l'immobilier. Il compare la performance de son portefeuille à l'indice FTSE EPRA/NAREIT Developed Europe Capped Net Total Return. TR Property Investment Trust plc a été créée en 1905 et est domiciliée au Royaume-Uni.
